prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A cheerful family breakfast with banana, egg, milk, juice, cheese, jam and biscuits. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "Breakfast Time". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Breakfast, banana, butter, cheese.
One egg, some milk, some juice, please.
Jam and biscuit beside the cup.
Eat together, wake with the sun.
Fresh food, one happy start.
Thank the family with the heart.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
